book.c0de_net.net.name: c0de net Handbook
book.c0de_net.net.landing_text: c0de net adds the libraries c0de\_net/http and c0de\_net/mail to c0de. With them, programs send HTTP requests to web servers and REST APIs and read the answers, send mail and read mailboxes. This handbook describes the types, the functions, the errors and the settings, with examples.
